source.snippet: Asking this in 2026 because the 2012 answers are now obsolete. In my country one can only access youtube with a VPN, but the connections drops every 3-5 minutes so I need a way to make youtube buffer the whole video instead of just the next 1 minute.

problem_statement: Users in countries with restricted or unstable internet access cannot reliably watch video content; VPN connections drop frequently and buffering workarounds are outdated, making video consumption painful.
target_segment: Internet users in countries with censored or unreliable connectivity who rely on VPNs for video access
notes: Recurring pain across restricted-internet regions (signal recurs across years). Could productize as a browser extension or desktop app that pre-caches/downloads video segments. Existing VPN users are already paying customers; upsell or companion tool opportunity.
